variants.cockpit: Commander and pilot sit in front of three touchscreen displays hanging from the panel; flight is automatic, manual attitude and translation commands are entered on the screens with the docking camera shown on the same display.
variants.notes: Touchscreen controls, not physical hand controllers; physical button labels beyond the three listed are not public (low).

aircraft.name: Buran orbiter
aircraft.summary: Soviet reusable orbiter that flew once, uncrewed and fully automatic, in November 1988; the cockpit was laid out for a commander and a pilot with sticks, pedals and a translation controller.
